docs.title: 3.1 Examination of Existing CTX Holdings
docs.text: The repository inventory lists 10 Context Camera (CTX) observation products over Jezero Crater in zuhura-data/catalogs/ctx_jezero_inventory.json: - Local File on Disk: zuhura-data/data/raw/ctx/P02_001820_1984_XI_18N282W.IMG (size: 36.2 MB). - Format: NASA PDS3 Experiment Data Record (DATA_SET_ID = "MRO-M-CTX-2-EDR-L0-V1.0"). - Data Content: Raw 8-bit uncalibrated pushbroom detector DN values ($5056 \times 7168$ pixels). - Georeferencing: None embedded (raw detector coordinates; requires SPICE kernel ephemeris projection). - Physical Property: Monoscopic optical radiance / reflectance. - Scientific Determination: This file is IMAGERY ONLY. It contains zero elevation data and cannot be queried for topographic height, slope, or profiles.

docs.title: Stereo Geometry Feasibility in CTX Catalog:
docs.text: Analyzing the emission angles in the CTX inventory reveals: - Observation 1: P02_001820_1984 — Emission Angle: $1.85^\circ$ (near-nadir), Incidence: $55.6^\circ$. - Observation 2: P04_002743_1987 — Emission Angle: $26.99^\circ$ (off-nadir), Incidence: $60.2^\circ$. - Stereo Convergence Angle ($\Delta \theta$): $\approx 25.1^\circ$ (ideal stereo baseline, $B/H \approx 0.45$). - Feasibility Assessment: The observations form a scientifically viable stereo pair suitable for DEM generation. However, generating a validated CTX DEM requires: 1. Full radiometric calibration (mroctx2isis). 2. SPICE kernel attachment (spiceinit). 3. Photogrammetric stereo bundle adjustment and dense disparity matching using the NASA Ames Stereo Pipeline (ASP) (stereo_corr / stereo_rfne). 4. Triangulation and point-cloud interpolation to a $20\text{ m/px}$ grid. 5. Absolute vertical alignment to MOLA altimetry tracks (pc_align). - Conclusion: Without running ASP, the CTX holdings remain optical imagery only.

It has no quantitative elevation values.

docs.title: Stereo Geometry Feasibility in HiRISE Catalog:
docs.text: The HiRISE inventory catalog contains: - PSP_004299_1985 (Emission Angle: $3.5^\circ$, near-nadir). - ESP_016219_1980 (Emission Angle: $30.2^\circ$, off-nadir). - ESP_016364_1980 (Emission Angle: $15.3^\circ$, intermediate). - Stereo Geometry: Pair PSP_004299 + ESP_016219 covers the Perseverance touchdown ellipse with $\Delta \theta \approx 26.7^\circ$ ($B/H \approx 0.48$). - Feasibility Assessment: A stereo pair exists in the NASA PDS archives. However, generating a HiRISE DTM ($1.0\text{ m/px}$) from raw EDR channel files requires terabytes of intermediate storage, High-Performance Computing (HPC) nodes, and weeks of manual GCP control editing to prevent jitter artifacts. - Pre-computed Alternative: The USGS Astrogeology Science Center and University of Arizona HiRISE team have already generated, peer-reviewed, and published the authoritative Jezero Crater HiRISE DTM (DTEEC_004299_1985_004444_1985_U01.IMG) at $1.0\text{ m/px}$ posting. Ingesting this pre-computed validated product is far superior to attempting local stereo generation from browse imagery.

docs.title: 5.1 Vertical Datum Alignment Protocol
docs.text: When high-resolution regional DTMs (e.g. HiRISE $1\text{ m}$ DTMs or CTX $20\text{ m}$ DTMs) are ingested in the future, they must undergo the Zuhura Vertical Datum Alignment Protocol: 1. Vertical Datum Conversion: Most HiRISE DTMs are generated with reference to an auxiliary sphere or an ellipsoidal datum ($h$). They must be converted to areoid elevation ($H = h - N$) using the MOLA GMM-3 geoid model. 2. Ground Control Alignment: Regional DTMs frequently exhibit bulk vertical offsets (typically $5 - 25\text{ m}$) relative to MOLA due to spacecraft orbit ephemeris drift. A 3D rigid body alignment (pc_align or least-squares surface matching) against filtered MOLA PEDR laser altimetry tracks must be applied. 3. No Mismatched Blending: The system will never blend or feather low-resolution and high-resolution DTMs in a way that obscures data boundaries. Instead, queries will report the exact source raster that yielded the measurement.

docs.title: 6. Audit Conclusion & Recommendations
docs.text:
1. Proceed with Stage 8 using MOLA MEG128: The existing MOLA global COG and polar DEMs provide a completely validated, globally contiguous, and geodetically sound foundation for Stage 8 terrain intelligence.
  2. Strict Provenance Reporting: All Stage 8 endpoints must explicitly declare horizontal_resolution_m: 463.06 and vertical_datum: "MOLA GMM-3 Areoid". The API will reject any attempt to represent interpolated 463 m data as sub-meter terrain.
  3. Defer Stereo Pipeline Processing: Do not attempt to run photogrammetric stereo processing on CTX EDR or HiRISE browse images in Stage 8. Stereo photogrammetry requires dedicated tooling (ASP/ISIS3) and belongs in a specialized future offline pipeline.

docs.title: 5. Risk Analysis & Mitigation Matrix
docs.text: Risk ID Risk Description Severity Likelihood Mitigation Strategy R-01 Latitudinal Scale Distortion: Inaccurate slope calculation at high latitudes due to meridian convergence. High High Strictly enforce metric tensor scaling: $\Delta x(\phi) = \Delta x_0 \cos(\phi)$ in all finite-difference calculations. R-02 Polar Boundary Discontinuity: Out-of-bounds error when query latitude exceeds $\pm 88^\circ$. Medium Medium Implement automatic routing to Polar Stereographic DEMs (megt_n_128_1.tif) with explicit CRS metadata in response. R-03 Transect Memory Spikes: User requesting 500 samples across the planet triggering massive raster load. Medium Low Read only bounding-box window or point-sample directly; clamp maximum sample count to 500 and maximum distance to $10,000\text{ km}$. R-04 Antimeridian / Origin Wrap: Profile crossing $0^\circ/360^\circ$ or $180^\circ$ failing on array index lookups. High Medium Implement modulo normalization on all coordinate lookups and handle window splits across $0^\circ\text{E}$ boundary. R-05 Terrain Clamping Failure in UI: Polyline sinking below Cesium 3D terrain surface. Medium Medium Use Cesium clampToGround: true on PolylineGraphics and query height via scene.globe.getHeight(). R-06 Misrepresenting Resolution: Interpolated 463 m MOLA data perceived as high-resolution rover terrain. Critical Low Mandate explicit provenance block in every API response declaring source resolution ($463\text{ m/px}$) and uncertainty.

docs.title: 6. Execution Boundaries & Non-Regression Rules
docs.text:
1. No Production API Modification: Existing /api/v1/elevation and /api/v1/rasters/* remain intact and functional.
  2. No Dataset Re-writes: mola_global_meg128_cog.tif, regional subsets, and Quantized-Mesh tiles are consumed strictly in read-only mode.
  3. Automated Regression Testing: Before declaring any milestone complete, all Stage 1–7 test suites (27 backend tests, 33 zuhura-data tests, 4 frontend tests) must pass with zero failures.
  4. Gate Review: Implementation will not commence until the USER reviews and approves this Phase 1 Architecture and Plan.
